item.title: FitTrack Ad From Supplied Screenshots

turns.text: Make a 10-second widescreen 16:9 ad for FitTrack using both screenshots. Show the home screen first, then the workout screen, and finish with the app name. Clean, energetic, with an upbeat instrumental beat and no voiceover. Other copy is your call.

item.tests: Uses supplied app screenshots faithfully in a finished landscape ad rather than inventing replacement screens.

answer_sheet.Brand and source images: FitTrack; use app-home.png followed by app-workout.png.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Clean and energetic; other design choices are your call.
answer_sheet.On-screen wording: End with FitTrack; other copy is your call, in English.

must_haves: The final video is 10 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
The supplied FitTrack home screenshot appears before the supplied workout screenshot.
Both screenshots remain recognizable and readable, without invented replacement UI.
An upbeat instrumental track is audible, with no voiceover.

turns.text: Could you make an ad for FitTrack using both of these attached screenshots, the home screen pic and the workout screen pic? I’m excited to see the app presented as an ad, because I’ve been trying to imagine how it would feel in motion. The look should be clean and energetic, and somewhere in all that it needs to be 10 seconds long in widescreen 16:9. Please show the home screen first, then the workout screen, and finish with the app name, FitTrack. I’d like an upbeat instrumental beat with no voiceover, and any other copy is your call.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the ad because Magic Hour refused the request for **insufficient credits**. No video was created.

The request preserved your full brief:
- **10 seconds, widescreen 16:9**
- Home screenshot first, then workout screenshot
- Final **FitTrack** title card
- Clean, energetic motion with an upbeat instrumental beat and no voiceover

You’ll need additional credits to run it as specified; I haven’t shortened it or dropped either screenshot.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a polished clean energetic 10-second widescreen 16:9 fitness app advertisement using BOTH supplied screenshot references as the actual app UI, in the exact order specified. Preserve the screenshot layouts, labels, colors and proportions as faithfully as possible; present complete portrait screenshots within a widescreen motion-design composition, do not stretch them. Bright white background, strong blue and fresh green accents, subtle shadows, crisp modern typography, tasteful graphic lines and energetic smooth transitions. TIMELINE: 0.0-3.5 seconds: show ONLY the HOME SCREEN from @home prominently centered in a sleek portrait phone mockup, blue accents, gentle push-in; short surrounding headline 'Make every day count.' 3.5-7.5 seconds: clean rhythmic slide transition to the WORKOUT SCREEN from @workout in the phone mockup, green accents, gentle dynamic push-in; short headline 'Find your momentum.' 7.5-10.0 seconds: phone slides away to a clean white end card with large perfectly spelled app name 'FitTrack' centered, smaller tagline 'Track. Move. Thrive.' underneath, blue and green accent shapes settling; hold the FitTrack name clearly through the final frame. Home screen must appear FIRST, workout screen SECOND, and finish with FitTrack. No unrelated app screens, no human presenters, no extra logos. AUDIO: upbeat instrumental electronic fitness beat with punchy clean drums, bright synths and positive energetic feel, synchronized to transitions, satisfying musical finish at 10 seconds. Absolutely NO voiceover, NO speech, NO singing, NO vocals.
